ahb_global_signals.name: HCLK
ahb_global_signals.semantics: Bus clock. All bus signal timings related to the rising edge of HCLK.

ahb_global_signals.name: HRESETn
ahb_global_signals.semantics: Bus reset, active LOW. Resets the system and the bus. The only active-LOW signal in AHB.

ahb_manager_signals.name: HBURST
ahb_manager_signals.semantics: Burst type: 0b000 SINGLE, 0b001 INCR, 0b010 WRAP4, 0b011 INCR4, 0b100 WRAP8, 0b101 INCR8, 0b110 WRAP16, 0b111 INCR16.

ahb_manager_signals.name: HMASTLOCK
ahb_manager_signals.semantics: Indicates the current transfer is part of a locked sequence.

ahb_manager_signals.name: HPROT
ahb_manager_signals.semantics: Protection control. 4-bit basic / 7-bit extended (with Extended_Memory_Types property).
ahb_manager_signals.versions: Basic in all; HPROT[6:4] in AHB5

ahb_manager_signals.name: HNONSEC
ahb_manager_signals.semantics: 0=Secure, 1=Non-secure. Present if AHB5 Secure_Transfers property True.

ahb_manager_signals.name: HEXCL
ahb_manager_signals.semantics: 1=transfer is part of an Exclusive Access sequence. Present if AHB5 Exclusive_Transfers True.

ahb_manager_signals.name: HMASTER
ahb_manager_signals.semantics: Manager identifier (modified by interconnect to ensure uniqueness). Present if AHB5 Exclusive_Transfers True.

ahb_manager_signals.name: HTRANS
ahb_manager_signals.semantics: Transfer type: 0b00 IDLE, 0b01 BUSY, 0b10 NONSEQ, 0b11 SEQ.

ahb_manager_signals.name: HWSTRB
ahb_manager_signals.semantics: Write strobes (Issue C optional). HWSTRB[n] -> HWDATA[(8n+7):8n].

ahb_manager_signals.name: HWRITE
ahb_manager_signals.semantics: Transfer direction: 1=write (Manager drives HWDATA), 0=read (Subordinate drives HRDATA).

ahb_subordinate_signals.name: HREADYOUT
ahb_subordinate_signals.semantics: When HIGH indicates the transfer has finished on the bus; LOW extends the transfer (insert wait state). Multiplexor combines all HREADYOUTs into the single HREADY.

ahb_subordinate_signals.name: HEXOKAY
ahb_subordinate_signals.semantics: Exclusive Okay; 1=success, 0=failure of an Exclusive Transfer. Present if AHB5 Exclusive_Transfers True.

ahb_decoder_signals.name: HSELx
ahb_decoder_signals.semantics: Subordinate select for the current address phase. When asserted for a non-IDLE transfer, must be asserted in the same cycle as the address and other control signals.

ahb_multiplexor_signals.name: HRDATA
ahb_multiplexor_signals.semantics: Read data bus, selected by decoder (HSEL).

ahb_multiplexor_signals.name: HREADY
ahb_multiplexor_signals.semantics: When HIGH indicates to the Manager and all Subordinates that the previous transfer is complete.

ahb_multiplexor_signals.name: HEXOKAY
ahb_multiplexor_signals.semantics: Exclusive okay, selected by decoder. AHB5 only.

ahb_user_signals_AHB5.name: HWUSER
ahb_user_signals_AHB5.semantics: User signal on Write data channel.

ahb_user_signals_AHB5.name: HRUSER
ahb_user_signals_AHB5.semantics: User signal on Read data channel.

ahb_parity_check_signals_AHB5.name: HADDRCHK
ahb_parity_check_signals_AHB5.purpose: Parity check signal for HADDR (and the Manager control bits).

ahb_parity_check_signals_AHB5.name: HCTRLCHK
ahb_parity_check_signals_AHB5.purpose: Parity check signal for the address-phase control signals.

ahb_parity_check_signals_AHB5.name: HWDATACHK
ahb_parity_check_signals_AHB5.purpose: Parity check signal for HWDATA + HWSTRB.

apb_signals.name: PCLK
apb_signals.semantics: Clock; rising edge times all transfers on the APB.

apb_signals.name: PRESETn
apb_signals.semantics: Reset, active LOW; normally tied to system bus reset.

apb_signals.name: PSELx
apb_signals.semantics: Select; one PSELx per Subordinate, generated by the bridge.

apb_signals.name: PENABLE
apb_signals.semantics: Enable; indicates the second and subsequent cycles of an APB transfer (ACCESS phase).

apb_signals.name: PWRITE
apb_signals.semantics: Direction: HIGH = APB write access, LOW = APB read access.

apb_signals.name: PSTRB
apb_signals.semantics: Write strobes (APB4); PSTRB[n] -> PWDATA[(8n+7):8n]; must be all LOW on reads.

apb_signals.name: PREADY
apb_signals.semantics: Slave-driven ready; LOW extends an APB transfer (wait state).

apb_signals.name: PRDATA
apb_signals.semantics: Read data bus driven during read cycles.

apb_signals.name: PSLVERR
apb_signals.semantics: Transfer failure indicator. APB peripherals are not required to support this pin.

handshake_pairs.ahb_address_to_data: HSELx + HREADY co-sampled in Subordinate; HREADYOUT drives wait states; HRESP drives error response.
handshake_pairs.apb_setup_access: PSELx + PENABLE jointly indicate state; PREADY extends ACCESS.

dependency_graph.ahb_common_rule: Subordinate samples HSELx + address-phase signals only when HREADY=HIGH. Subordinate drives HREADYOUT to extend the data phase. AHB has no AXI-style VALID/READY decoupling — instead it uses HTRANS + HREADY co-sampled.
dependency_graph.ahb_address_phase: Address phase one cycle (extended only if previous data phase still active).
dependency_graph.ahb_data_phase: Data phase one or more cycles; controlled by HREADY.
dependency_graph.ahb_pipeline: Address phase of transfer N+1 overlaps data phase of transfer N.
dependency_graph.apb_state_transitions: IDLE -> SETUP on transfer-required; SETUP -> ACCESS unconditional next PCLK; ACCESS -> ACCESS while PREADY=0; ACCESS -> IDLE or SETUP on PREADY=1.

ordering_rules.ahb_strict_in_order: AHB-Lite is single-Manager and strictly in-order; one outstanding transfer with address/data pipelining.
ordering_rules.ahb_burst_order: Beats of a burst are in HBURST-defined order (incrementing or wrapping); all beats use same HSIZE / HWRITE / HPROT / HMASTLOCK.
ordering_rules.apb_strict_in_order: APB is single-Manager (bridge); strictly in-order; one transfer in progress at a time.

evidence.quote: HCLK Clock source: The bus clock times all bus transfers. HRESETn Reset controller: The bus reset signal is active LOW; the only active LOW signal.
HADDR, HBURST, HMASTLOCK, HPROT, HSIZE, HNONSEC (AHB5), HEXCL (AHB5), HMASTER (AHB5), HTRANS, HWDATA, HWSTRB, HWRITE.
HRDATA, HREADY, HRESP, HEXOKAY (selected by decoder).
PCLK, PRESETn, PADDR, PPROT, PSELx, PENABLE, PWRITE, PWDATA, PSTRB, PREADY, PRDATA, PSLVERR.
Optional HAUSER, HWUSER, HRUSER, HBUSER signals (user-defined widths).
HADDRCHK, HCTRLCHK, HWDATACHK, HRDATACHK, HRESPCHK, HREADYCHK parity check signals.
